limitation: The original frozen analyzer performed the saved-logit, tensor, checkpoint and minibatch audit. This independent pass recomputes pairing/arithmetic/thresholds/costs from published primitive arrays and checks the reported numerical-error bounds; it does not independently reload every raw NPZ or replay training.
method: Read-only independent arithmetic over published primitive arrays. Seed order is recovered from registered COMPLETE records and anchored independently with each wait4 CPU and peak RSS. No import or call of the original analyzer; no model retraining, gate adjustment or old-row substitution.
negative_findings: All18 prespecified external quality-conditioned comparisons fail; no equal-quality speed advantage over an external control is demonstrated.
At30trainingCPU seconds the accelerated HCSN still trails the strongest control on both content tasks.
Both HCSN backends are near12.5percent nominal chance after32updates on the eight-class content tasks.
The one-seed16update CREMA-D panel reaches17.5percent, with unchanged arithmetic late fusion; this is not multimodal foundation-model evidence.
The result is a faithful implementation speed improvement within this HCSN. The affine stopping reward remains a local surrogate, not a classification-optimal boundary.
No measured energy, GPU throughput, general SNN superiority or large-model scaling conclusion is supported.
